meta.name: Frontend Product Builder Collection Data Components
meta.description: Canonical components for structured collections, pagination, descriptive key-value information, and compact metadata.

DataTable.name: DataTable
DataTable.description: Canonical structured collection component for presenting sortable, selectable, paginated, server-backed, and action-oriented tabular data.
capabilities: Present structured records through meaningful columns and rows.
Support controlled sorting, selection, expansion, visibility, and pagination.
Represent loading, empty, no-results, partial, error, and refreshing states.
Preserve semantic table behavior and keyboard-accessible controls.
Provide controlled local overflow without causing page-level horizontal overflow.

foundation.source: TanStack Table with native HTML table semantics
foundation.reason: TanStack Table provides controlled headless state and row models while the product design system retains semantic markup, presentation, accessibility, responsive policy, and server-state ownership.

standard.intent: Present an ordinary operational collection with moderate density and complete row context.
prohibitedUse: Collection whose items require primarily visual card content.

compact.intent: Present a dense operational collection where repeated short values and frequent scanning justify reduced spacing.
prohibitedUse: Collection requiring several large inline actions.

comfortable.intent: Present records containing longer labels, supporting text, or larger interactive targets.

selectable.intent: Allow explicit selection for an approved bulk or comparison workflow.
prohibitedUse: Selection without any valid resulting action.
Selection used only to highlight a navigated row.
Hidden selection persistence across incompatible filters.

expandable.intent: Allow a row to disclose a bounded set of related details without navigating away.

comfortable.intent: Rows with descriptive or multiline content.

slots.name: caption
slots.description: Optional accessible description of the table purpose.
contentRestrictions: The caption describes the collection rather than repeating the page title.
A visually hidden caption remains meaningful to assistive technology.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Optional table-specific controls such as column visibility, density, export, and selected-row actions.
contentRestrictions: Search and primary route filters normally belong to the searchable-list recipe.
Low-frequency utilities move to overflow.
Selection actions render only when selection exists.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Column headings, sorting controls, and optional select-all control.
contentRestrictions: Every data column requires an understandable heading.
Icon-only headings require an accessible name.
Select-all scope must be explicit.

slots.name: body
slots.description: Current collection rows and cells.
contentRestrictions: Rows use stable record identifiers.
Cells must not render raw DTO objects.
Row actions remain separate from row navigation semantics.

slots.name: expandedContent
slots.description: Optional bounded content disclosed beneath an expanded row.
contentRestrictions: Expanded content must remain bounded.
Do not render a complete route or large nested table.

slots.name: state
slots.description: Loading, empty, no-results, error, permission, or unavailable collection state.
contentRestrictions: Only the component matching the actual state renders.
Existing rows remain visible during non-blocking refresh.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Pagination, result count, selection summary, and freshness context.
contentRestrictions: Do not duplicate result count in several regions.
Pagination is omitted when the complete collection fits on one page unless context still requires count.

props.name: columns
props.description: Approved semantic column definitions for the current collection.
restrictions: Column definitions must not be created inline when doing so causes unstable identity or avoidable rerenders.
Raw backend field names must be mapped to user-facing headers and cell renderers.
Column order follows task priority.

props.name: data
props.description: Current page or locally available collection records.
restrictions: The component does not fetch data.
Rows require stable identifiers.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Returns the stable identity of one record.
restrictions: Array index is prohibited as the row identity for mutable collections.

props.name: density
props.description: Semantic row and cell density.
restrictions: Do not override individual cell padding arbitrarily.

props.name: sorting
props.description: Controlled active sorting state.
restrictions: Server and client sorting must not be mixed accidentally.
The active sort must be reflected in query or URL state when shareability requires it.

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Controlled sorting-change callback.
restrictions: The table does not execute server requests directly.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Controlled selected-row state.
restrictions: Selection must be reconciled when filters, tenant, scope, or data identity changes.

props.name: onRowSelectionChange
props.description: Controlled row-selection callback.
restrictions: Selection side effects remain outside the table.

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicates initial collection loading when no usable rows exist.
restrictions: Background refreshing must not replace populated rows with skeletons.

props.name: refreshing
props.description: Indicates background synchronization while current rows remain available.
restrictions: Refreshing and loading must remain distinct.

spacingOwnership: DataTable owns spacing among table toolbar, table viewport, state presentation, and footer.
Table cells own their approved internal padding through the selected density.
The surrounding recipe region owns spacing around the complete table.
composition.surfaceOwnership: DataTable owns one collection surface and its internal borders; it must not place every row or cell inside independent cards.
rules: Use semantic HTML table elements for genuinely tabular information.
Do not use ARIA grid unless implementing full interactive-grid behavior.
Column priority is defined before responsive hiding or adaptation.
Critical information must not disappear on compact layouts.
Row navigation and row actions must not create nested interactive conflicts.
Table state is controlled by the owning feature, screen, or URL contract.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use only when the data is genuinely tabular and operationally actionable.
Primary implementation for tabular searchable collections.
Use for related records or audit indexes, not for the complete entity summary.
User, role, integration, and audit collections require capability-aware actions.
Evidence selection and review history may use tabular presentation when appropriate.

prohibited: Mapping raw DTO values into user-facing content.

notes: Sorting, filtering, pagination, visibility, expansion, and selection are supplied by the owning feature or screen.
Shareable table state may be URL-owned outside the component.
Server data remains TanStack Query-owned outside the component.
The table may manage focus among its own sorting, selection, expansion, and action controls.
The local table viewport may own horizontal scrolling.
Navigation, mutation, export, and clipboard behavior are supplied by consumers.

responsive.strategy: Preserve task-critical columns, move low-priority utilities to overflow, and use a locally owned horizontal viewport before silently removing essential data.
responsive.compact: Use approved critical columns, controlled local horizontal scrolling, or an explicit feature-level list adaptation. Row actions move to overflow.
responsive.medium: Display primary columns and selected supporting columns; low-priority columns may be hidden through an approved column-priority policy.
responsive.wide: Display the complete approved operational column set when width permits.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not stretch text columns excessively; distribute remaining space according to column semantics.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Horizontal overflow is owned by the table viewport. Page-level horizontal overflow is prohibited.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Columns must adapt, wrap, or scroll locally before text, actions, or selection controls become unusable at 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.semanticElement: native table, thead, tbody, tr, th, and td elements
accessibility.accessibleName: Visible or visually hidden table caption describing the collection.
keyboard: Expansion controls expose their state and are keyboard operable.
Row action menus are keyboard operable.
Ordinary non-interactive cells do not become unnecessary tab stops.
focus: Focus order follows visible controls in DOM order.
Background refresh does not reset focus.
Pagination changes move focus according to the approved collection-navigation policy.
Expanded-row controls preserve logical focus when content closes.
announcements: Sorted column and direction are exposed.
Selection count may be announced when it changes through explicit user action.
Loading, no-results, and errors are announced by their canonical feedback components.
Background refreshing does not produce excessive announcements.
aria: Use aria-sort on sortable column headers.
Use native scope semantics for headers.
Use accessible labels for icon-only action and selection controls.
Do not apply role=grid without implementing the complete interaction model.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Sort, selection, expansion, status, disabled rows, and action eligibility use text, icons, semantics, or shape in addition to color.

content.minimum: One meaningful column and one record, or a canonical collection state.
content.typical: Several task-oriented columns, repeated records, optional row actions, and controlled pagination.
content.maximum: A large server-backed collection whose current page remains bounded and whose columns follow explicit priority.
content.wrapping: Text columns wrap when appropriate; compact identifiers may remain on one line; actions and badges follow their own contracts.
content.truncation: Truncation is allowed only for secondary values when the full value remains accessible and critical distinctions remain visible.
content.localization: Column headings, values, actions, empty states, and pagination support localized expansion.
content.emptyBehavior: Initial empty and filtered no-results states use distinct EmptyState variants.
content.technicalContent: Raw DTO keys, JSON payloads, internal enum values, database IDs, and transport errors are prohibited unless an explicitly approved administrative column requires safe technical data.

browserScenarios: 390x844 local overflow or approved list adaptation

notes: The shared DataTable is not responsible for server filtering, pagination requests, domain mapping, or mutations.
Feature-level table adapters may define columns and data mapping without duplicating the canonical visual and interaction implementation.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.description: Canonical controlled navigation for moving through bounded pages of a collection while exposing result count, current position, and optional page-size control.
capabilities: Navigate to previous, next, first, last, or numbered collection pages.
Communicate current page and total page context.
Expose result count and current visible range.
Allow an approved page-size selection.
Transform into a compact navigation model when width is limited.

foundation.reason: Collection pagination requires controlled state, accessible labels, bounded page calculation, responsive transformation, result-range semantics, and integration with server-backed collections.

numbered.intent: Expose neighboring page numbers with previous and next navigation.
allowedUse: Desktop collection with a known total page count.
Collection where direct neighboring-page navigation is useful.
prohibitedUse: Cursor-based collection without stable page numbers.
Compact region where numbered controls cannot fit.

compact.intent: Expose current page context and previous or next navigation without a full page-number sequence.
allowedUse: Moderate collection with simple sequential navigation.
prohibitedUse: Workflow requiring frequent direct access to distant pages.

cursor.intent: Navigate a cursor-backed collection through previous and next availability rather than numeric pages.
allowedUse: Continuously changing collection where offset pagination is unsafe.

compact.intent: Compact collection footer or narrow layout.

slots.name: rangeSummary
slots.description: Visible range and total-result context.
contentRestrictions: Do not claim a total count when the server does not provide one.
Use localized number formatting.

slots.name: pageSize
slots.description: Optional approved page-size selector.
contentRestrictions: Offer only approved values.
Changing size must resolve page bounds safely.

slots.name: navigation
slots.description: Previous, next, numbered, first, or last page controls.
contentRestrictions: Every icon-only control requires an accessible name.
The current page is not presented as an ordinary navigation action.

slots.name: pageContext
slots.description: Compact current-page and total-page label.
contentRestrictions: Required in compact mode when numbered pages are not displayed.

props.name: variant
props.description: Collection-navigation model matching the backend and available width.
restrictions: Cursor-backed APIs must not use numbered pagination unless the backend supplies stable numeric pages.

props.name: page
props.description: Controlled one-based current page for numbered pagination.
restrictions: Must remain within valid bounds.
Use one consistent indexing convention at the component boundary.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Authoritative total number of pages.
restrictions: Required for numbered mode.
Do not estimate from incomplete data.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Controlled number of records requested per page.
restrictions: Must be one of the approved page-size values.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Approved page-size values.
restrictions: Avoid excessively large values that degrade performance or usability.

props.name: totalCount
props.description: Authoritative total result count when available.
restrictions: Null means the total is not known and must not be displayed as zero.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Controlled numbered-page navigation callback.
restrictions: The component does not execute the server request.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Controlled page-size change callback.
restrictions: The owning feature determines how the current page resets or reconciles.

props.name: hasPreviousPage
props.description: Authoritative previous-page availability.
restrictions: Required for cursor mode.

props.name: hasNextPage
props.description: Authoritative next-page availability.
restrictions: Required for cursor mode.

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicates that a requested page transition is pending.
restrictions: Current records should normally remain visible while the next page loads.

spacingOwnership: Pagination owns spacing among result range, page-size selector, page context, and navigation controls.
The containing collection owns spacing above the pagination footer.
composition.surfaceOwnership: Pagination normally inherits the containing collection surface and does not create an independent card.
rules: The pagination model must match the backend contract.
Unknown totals remain unknown rather than zero.
Current-page controls remain semantically distinct from available navigation.
Changing the page does not silently discard unrelated table state unless explicitly required.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use when the collection exceeds one server or local page.
Administrative and audit collections may use numbered or cursor pagination.
Related-record and audit collections may require pagination.
Dashboard queues should normally show a bounded priority subset and navigate to the full collection.

notes: Page, page size, cursor availability, total count, and pending state are supplied by the owning collection.
Shareable pagination may be URL-owned outside the component.
Callbacks request navigation but do not execute route or server behavior directly.
The owning collection controls any scroll-to-results behavior.

responsive.strategy: Reduce page-number controls before sacrificing result context, previous or next navigation, or usable targets.
responsive.compact: Use compact mode with previous, current-page context, and next controls. Page-size selection may move to a secondary row or overflow.
responsive.medium: Display a bounded page-number sequence and wrapping result context.
responsive.wide: Display result range, page size, neighboring pages, and previous or next controls.
responsive.ultrawide: Remain compact and aligned to the collection rather than expanding across the route.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Controls wrap or collapse into compact mode; horizontal page overflow is prohibited.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Pagination must transform before control labels or touch targets become unusable at 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.accessibleName: Explicit label such as Paginação da lista de processos.
keyboard: All page controls and page-size selectors are keyboard operable.
Disabled unavailable controls cannot be activated.
Current-page state remains perceivable without activation.
focus: Focus remains on the activated control until the owning collection applies its navigation-focus policy.
A changed page must not move focus to the browser top unexpectedly.
Compact transformation preserves logical DOM order.
announcements: The owning collection may announce the new visible result range after navigation.
Loading transitions do not repeatedly announce every internal state change.
aria: Use aria-current=page for the current numeric page.
Icon-only previous, next, first, and last controls require explicit labels.
The navigation landmark requires a meaningful accessible name.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Current page, disabled navigation, and pending state use semantics, text, shape, or icon in addition to color.

content.minimum: Previous and next availability or one current-page context.
content.typical: Visible result range, page-size selector, page numbers, and previous or next controls.
content.maximum: A bounded neighboring-page sequence rather than one control for every page.
content.wrapping: Summary and controls may wrap into multiple rows.
content.truncation: Do not truncate current-page or result-range context.
content.localization: Support expanded page labels, number formatting, and pluralization.
content.emptyBehavior: Pagination is normally omitted when the collection contains no records.
content.technicalContent: Cursor values, offset values, request tokens, and backend pagination keys are prohibited.

DefinitionList.name: DefinitionList
DefinitionList.description: Canonical semantic presentation for labeled values, attributes, configuration details, summaries, and read-only entity information.
capabilities: Present labels and corresponding values using semantic definition-list markup.
Distinguish zero, unknown, unavailable, restricted, and not-applicable values.
Support stacked, aligned, and responsive grid presentations.
Preserve readable line lengths for long descriptive values.
Expose optional value actions without turning the complete row into an interactive control.

foundation.source: HTML dl, dt, and dd elements with shared layout tokens
foundation.reason: Definition-list semantics correctly represent label-value relationships while shared composition controls spacing, responsive alignment, missing-value presentation, and optional actions.

stacked.intent: Present each label above its value for narrow layouts, long content, or irregular value lengths.
prohibitedUse: Dense repeated short metadata where an aligned layout improves scanning.

aligned.intent: Present labels in one constrained column and values in a flexible adjacent column.
prohibitedUse: Very long or highly variable labels.
Several unrelated definition groups forced into one list.

grid.intent: Present several independent short label-value items through a responsive descriptive grid.
prohibitedUse: Values whose relationships require table semantics.

bordered.intent: Separate a bounded group of operational attributes with subtle dividers.

slots.name: groupTitle
slots.description: Optional heading identifying a coherent definition group.
contentRestrictions: Use only when the list represents a meaningful subsection.
Heading level follows the containing screen hierarchy.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One semantic label-value relationship.
contentRestrictions: Every value requires a user-facing label.
Items must belong to one coherent group.

slots.name: label
slots.description: The term or attribute name.
contentRestrictions: Do not use raw DTO or database property names.
Do not encode required meaning only through punctuation.

slots.name: value
slots.description: The corresponding user-facing value.
contentRestrictions: Unknown, unavailable, zero, and not applicable remain distinct.
Technical values require explicit approval and safe formatting.

slots.name: supporting
slots.description: Optional supporting explanation, freshness, provenance, or restriction context.
contentRestrictions: Supporting content remains subordinate to the value.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Optional value-specific action such as copy, open, or reveal.
contentRestrictions: Action applies only to the associated value.
Icon-only actions require accessible names.
The complete item must not become accidentally interactive.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic presentation matching content length, relationship, and container width.
restrictions: Do not select grid only to fill unused horizontal space.

props.name: size
props.description: Density matching the value complexity and region priority.
restrictions: Do not reduce density when it harms label-value association.

props.name: columns
props.description: Maximum approved grid columns when the grid variant is selected.
restrictions: The component collapses columns before values become unreadable.
Three columns require short values and sufficient container width.

prohibitedChildren: Editable form controls presented as read-only values
spacingOwnership: DefinitionList owns spacing among its direct definition items.
DefinitionItem owns spacing among label, value, supporting content, and action.
The containing section owns spacing around the complete list.
composition.surfaceOwnership: DefinitionList owns no surface by default; bordered treatment owns subtle separators and one coherent surface when selected.
rules: Use semantic definition-list markup for label-value relationships.
Use DataTable when values form repeated records with meaningful columns.
Use FormField and form controls when values are editable.
Missing-value states use approved user-facing representations.
Labels and values remain associated at every responsive width.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for bounded context, not for primary metric presentation.
Primary component for read-only entity attributes.
Use for prerequisite or related-entity context, not editable fields.
Use for configuration summary, identity, impact, and safe diagnostics.
Use for provenance, impact, source details, and prior decision attributes.

notes: The owning entity or feature maps domain values into user-facing label-value content.
Optional value actions receive explicit callbacks from the owning feature.

responsive.strategy: Collapse aligned and grid presentations into stacked label-value groups before labels, values, or actions become difficult to associate.
responsive.compact: Use stacked presentation with labels above values and actions aligned to their associated values.
responsive.medium: Use stacked or a constrained two-column grid according to content.
responsive.wide: Use aligned or grid presentation when labels and values remain readable.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not add columns merely to consume available width; preserve reading length.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Labels, values, supporting content, and actions wrap. Long safe identifiers may use approved copy behavior.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Aligned and grid variants must collapse before association or readability degrades at 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.semanticElement: dl containing dt and dd elements
accessibility.accessibleName: Optional visible group heading supplied by the containing section or list.
keyboard: Static definition content is not focusable.
Optional copy, reveal, and navigation actions are keyboard operable.
focus: Interactive value actions follow their associated value in DOM order.
Responsive layout changes do not reorder semantic label-value relationships.
announcements: Dynamic value changes are announced only when operationally meaningful through the owning feature.
Restricted or unavailable values use their canonical semantic components.
aria: Use native dl, dt, and dd elements.
Do not use table or grid roles for ordinary definition content.
Icon-only value actions require explicit labels.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Unavailable, restricted, status, and changed values use text and semantics in addition to color.

content.typical: Several related attributes with labels, values, and occasional supporting context.
content.maximum: A coherent read-only information group; large repeated record sets require DataTable.
content.wrapping: Labels and values wrap naturally and remain associated.
content.truncation: Primary values are not truncated without full-value access; long secondary identifiers may truncate safely.
content.localization: Support expanded labels, values, date formats, number formats, and missing-value terms.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty list normally does not render; the owning region chooses an appropriate EmptyState when the complete information group is absent.
content.technicalContent: Technical identifiers and diagnostic values are permitted only in explicitly approved administrative or audit contexts and require safe labels and formatting.

MetadataList.name: MetadataList
MetadataList.description: Canonical compact presentation for small supporting facts such as ownership, timestamps, scope, category, source, and secondary identifiers.
capabilities: Present a bounded set of supporting metadata.
Arrange metadata inline, wrapped, or stacked according to the containing region.
Expose labels when values would otherwise be ambiguous.
Support icons, status labels, timestamps, and safe value actions.
Remain visually subordinate to primary identity and content.

foundation.source: Native list semantics, Stack, Badge, Tooltip
foundation.reason: Compact metadata needs bounded anatomy, semantic labels, consistent separators, responsive wrapping, safe truncation, and visual subordination.

inline.intent: Present a short sequence of supporting facts on one wrapping line.
prohibitedUse: More than a small bounded set of items.

wrapped.intent: Present a bounded metadata collection that may flow across multiple lines.
allowedUse: Compact summary with several short facts.
prohibitedUse: Large detailed attribute set better represented by DefinitionList.

stacked.intent: Present several supporting facts vertically in a narrow contextual region.

labeled.intent: Present compact metadata whose values require visible short labels.
prohibitedUse: Long labels or complex values requiring DefinitionList.

compact.intent: Dense metadata in tables and compact headers.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One supporting metadata fact.
contentRestrictions: The complete list remains bounded.
Items must support the current task context.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Optional supporting icon associated with one metadata item.
contentRestrictions: The icon is not the only source of meaning.
Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Optional concise visible label for an ambiguous value.
contentRestrictions: Use user-facing terminology.
Long labels require DefinitionList.

slots.name: value
slots.description: Supporting metadata value.
contentRestrictions: Unknown, unavailable, and restricted remain distinct.
Raw enum keys and internal identifiers are prohibited by default.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Optional safe metadata-specific action.
contentRestrictions: Actions remain low emphasis.
Copy actions require meaningful labels.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic arrangement matching item count, value ambiguity, and containing width.
restrictions: Do not use inline for content requiring a persistent visible relationship between long labels and values.

props.name: size
props.description: Metadata density and typography scale.
restrictions: Metadata remains subordinate to primary content.

props.name: separator
props.description: Approved visual separator between inline metadata items.
restrictions: Separators are hidden appropriately from assistive technology.
Stacked layouts normally use none.

prohibitedParents: Tooltip as the complete metadata surface
spacingOwnership: MetadataList owns spacing and separators among direct metadata items.
MetadataItem owns spacing among its icon, label, value, and action.
The containing component owns spacing around the complete list.
rules: Metadata remains secondary to the primary identity or content.
Use DefinitionList when the collection grows or values require stronger label association.
Critical information must not be demoted into metadata.
Separators remain decorative and do not replace semantic list structure.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for freshness, scope, source, and secondary metric context.
Use for row supporting context and collection scope.
Use for essential secondary entity orientation.
Use for environment, organization, ownership, and audit context.
Use for source, author, time, model provenance, and review context.

prohibited: Reading environment or tenant context directly.

notes: The owning screen, entity, or feature supplies user-facing metadata items.
Optional navigation and copy callbacks are supplied by the owning feature.

responsive.strategy: Wrap or stack metadata before values become unreadable, while preserving visual subordination and semantic list order.
responsive.compact: Inline lists wrap or transform into stacked items when labels and values no longer fit.
responsive.medium: Use inline, wrapped, or labeled presentation according to the containing component.
responsive.wide: Use concise inline or wrapped presentation.
responsive.ultrawide: Remain bounded and do not add low-value metadata to fill space.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Metadata wraps; approved identifiers may truncate only when full value remains accessible.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Inline metadata must wrap or stack before association and readability degrade at 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.semanticElement: ul and li elements or an equivalent semantic list
accessibility.accessibleName: Provided by the containing component when the metadata collection requires a label.
keyboard: Optional links, copy controls, and actions are keyboard operable.
focus: Interactive metadata actions follow their associated value.
announcements: Dynamic freshness or status changes are announced by the specialized child component when required.
Static separators are hidden from assistive technology.
aria: Decorative icons and separators are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Status, freshness, unavailable, and restricted metadata use text and semantics in addition to color.

content.typical: Two to five short metadata items.
content.maximum: A bounded set of supporting facts; larger or more complex sets require DefinitionList.
content.wrapping: Inline metadata wraps as whole item groups where possible.
content.truncation: Secondary identifiers may truncate when the full value remains accessible; timestamps, statuses, and critical scope labels must remain understandable.
content.localization: Support expanded labels, dates, names, statuses, and separators appropriate to locale.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty MetadataList does not render.
content.technicalContent: Technical identifiers are allowed only when explicitly relevant to an authorized administrative or audit task.

checks.description: The collection data-display catalog must validate against the component catalog schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing component catalog fields.

checks.description: Collection component IDs, names, implementations, public imports, and canonical responsibilities must remain unique.
checks.remediation: Resolve duplicate ownership or merge overlapping collection components.

checks.description: Shared collection and descriptive components must not execute queries, mutations, permission checks, routing, or transport parsing.
checks.remediation: Move data access, domain mapping, permissions, and side effects to the owning entity, feature, or route.

checks.description: DataTable must use semantic table markup and expose sorting, selection, expansion, state, and action behavior accessibly.
checks.remediation: Correct table markup, control semantics, accessible labels, focus behavior, or state composition.

checks.description: Tables, definition lists, metadata lists, and pagination must be selected according to the actual information relationship rather than visual preference.
checks.remediation: Replace the component with the canonical data presentation matching the semantic relationship.

checks.description: Collection components must remain usable without page-level horizontal overflow across approved viewports and zoom levels.
checks.remediation: Correct table viewport ownership, column priority, wrapping, pagination transformation, or definition-list collapse.

checks.description: Unknown, zero, unavailable, restricted, not applicable, and loading values must remain distinguishable.
checks.remediation: Correct value mapping and use the approved user-facing missing-value representation.

checks.description: Page-local tables, pagination controls, key-value grids, and metadata rows similar to canonical components require review.
checks.remediation: Reuse the canonical component or document why the local composition is semantically distinct.
